# Dear ImGui 1.91.9b

Vendored from https://github.com/ocornut/imgui/releases/tag/v1.91.9b.
Unmodified core sources and official Win32 / OpenGL3 backends. Retain LICENSE.txt.
Optional BUILD_IMGUI_GUI enables it only for the visualization/tool targets.
The first native bridge targets Windows; no Qt, Python, GLFW or SDL is required.
